On Sat, Nov 21, 2026 at 09:20 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Immediate mitigation I recommend right now...

Checked infra telemetry: we're seeing a correlated spike in request queue length on the primary serving fleet starting 09:08 PT. The rate limiter is tripping for a heavy proportion of clients (429s), while a subset of older model-variant nodes are returning 503/timeout when their KV cache thrashes. Key options we can do in parallel (ordered by speed):

1) Increase transient burst pool from reserved capacity (5-15 minutes) — available but will increase cost.
2) Flip routing for LaunchOps tenant to fallback variant (gpt-small-q4_1) for non-critical endpoints — reduces per-token latency and load.
3) Temporarily relax per-tenant token rate limiter by 20% for 30 minutes and attach stricter global backoff policy.
4) Enable aggressive prefix caching for common endpoints (customers with identical prefixes) — requires cache warm-up ~2-5 minutes.

I'll start (1) and (2) now if you approve. I will also attach the Grafana snapshot to this thread (see link). Will post telemetry updates in 5-min intervals.
